title: Asexual Reproduction
summary: One parent, identical offspring: vegetative propagation in plants, and fission, budding, fragmentation and spores.

ib.note: Mitosis and cloning are formalised in MYP 5 / CBSE 10

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 12: Reproduction in Plants

objectives: I can explain asexual reproduction and give examples.
I can describe vegetative propagation using stems, leaves, roots, tubers and bulbs.
I can evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of asexual reproduction.
misconceptions: Plants can only reproduce from seeds.
Offspring from cuttings are different from the parent.
